reference_scores: 50-run scores are in the shared spatial file's <method>_uncertainty observation column.
selection: First K runs from seeds 42 through 91; leave-one-run-out instability; values above 1 are retained.
source: Saved 1-nested-non-sampling instability results, copied losslessly without recomputation.
spatial_panel: Every spot is retained at each plotted run count.
transition_panel: Every paired spot contributes to the 50-versus-K transition counts.
hexbin_panel: A deterministic sample of at most 10000 spots per sample, shared across K (NumPy default_rng seed 42).
cluster_metrics: ../metrics/clusterwise_metrics.csv stores expression coherence/variance once for each of 1414 fixed example_50 clusters. cluster_metrics.load_cluster_metrics reconstructs run-dependent instability, sizes, reference indices/seeds, and annotation metrics from shared labels, annotations, and spot scores.
cluster_definition: First run with the minimum cluster count among all 50 runs; clusters remain fixed across K.
expression_metrics: From saved normalized/log1p counts, centered PCA, and unit-length first 20 PCs; expression matrices are not required to plot. All fixed metrics were verified identical across the ten original run counts before removing repetition.
annotation_metrics: Maximum-Jaccard annotation match on nonmissing annotation spots; the same match defines Jaccard, recall, and precision.
